title: OrderMarksCompleted v1 payload
description: Every marked line of the order now holds all the marking codes it needs (ADR 0161). A nudge, not a ledger: the fiscal module re-reads the counts to reopen a document blocked MARKS_INCOMPLETE, and a removal after completion publishes nothing, so consumers treat the current count as the truth. Identifiers and counts only: a marking code, its GTIN and the customer are never in an event (ADR 0029).
